case_name: Smt. Khushbu Soni @ Situ W/O Shri Vishnu ... vs Vishnu Kumar Soni S/O Shri Kishanlal ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Khushbu Soni @ Situ W/o Shri Vishnu, wife
parties.respondent_defendant: Vishnu Kumar Soni S/o Shri Kishanlal Soni, husband

facts_of_case: The applicant-wife seeks transfer of a divorce case from Family Court, Dausa to Pali due to distance and lack of support.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant seeking transfer to establish that the transfer is necessary in the interest of justice.
legal_principles.held: Considering the contentions put forth by both the sides and considering the fact that the applicant-wife is presently residing in Pali; that the distance between Pali and Dausa is over 370 Km;
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022
Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay & Ors.: AIR 2002 SC 396
Rajni Kishor Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Par

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another district if the applicant can demonstrate that it is necessary in the interest of justice.
legal_principles.held: Considering the provisions of Section 19 of the Hindu Marriage Act and relying upon the judgments of the Apex Court
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022
Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay & Ors.: AIR 2002 SC 396
Rajni Kishor Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Par

outcome.final_order: Transfer of the case is granted to Family Court, Pali.
